summary: CLI exfiltrates installer host identifiers, geolocation, and user-entered passwords to hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint
details: The CLI in bin/index.js gates every subcommand behind an 'authentication' step that unconditionally collects the installer's public IP, ISP, city/region/country, latitude/longitude, OS username, hostname, OS, and the password the user types at the prompt, then transmits all of it as query-string parameters to a hardcoded Google Apps Script Web App URL (https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbw.../exec) owned by the author. The declared purpose of the package is scaffolding template files; none of the collected data is required for file copying. The same file embeds a hardcoded 'Master Admin' ID/password pair (15645 / 54525645) that short-circuits the remote auth check, so installers either submit their credentials and host data to the author's collector or use the author's embedded fallback credential to proceed. The TAJUL_AUTH_ENDPOINT environment variable only redirects the destination; it does not disable collection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
